subject: Up-sell / Renewal kickoff: timeline, QBR scheduling & ops checklist
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@gridly.ai>, Gridly Ops <ops@gridly.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Up-sell / Renewal kickoff: timeline, QBR scheduling & ops checklist

Hi Olivia / Gridly team —

Thanks again for the productive call last week. As discussed, this thread will serve as the kickoff for the renewal + capacity uplift (term shift to 24 months, +20% token commit for peak season) and to lock in a QBR window to align execs and ops. High level plan and asks below — please confirm owners and any timeline constraints by end of week.

Quick overview / proposed timeline
- Week 0 (now): Kickoff + mutual action plan (MAP) shared — see attachment.
- Week 1: Procurement and legal scope (Gridly & Redwood legal leads).
- Week 2: Security evidence and KMS/scoping (Gridly Ops / Redwood Security).
- Week 3: Finalize SOW + PO submission.
- Week 4: Term signature and QBR (operational readiness review).

Key asks (please):
1) Confirm who will own procurement/PO (name + email).
2) Ops: confirm current region(s) you want reserved (us-west-2 / us-east-1).
3) Legal: any non-standard terms we should surface now?
4) QBR: pick preferred 2 windows in the next 3 weeks (link below).

Attachments: Gridly_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v2.xlsx (MAP stub), SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (list of evidence items we will request)
Related links: https://redwood.app/drive/MutualAction/DEAL-4821 (MAP), calendar poll: https://cal.com/redwood/qbr-availability

Next steps from Redwood: Marcus will draft the term amendment and Kimberley will surface any governance/security must-haves. I (Mina) will coordinate the QBR and procurement deadlines.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@gridly.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Gridly Ops <ops@gridly.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Up-sell / Renewal kickoff: timeline, QBR scheduling & ops checklist

Mina —

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers from our side:
- Procurement lead: Samir Patel (samir.patel@gridly.ai) — he owns POs and vendor onboarding.
- Ops: primary region is us-west-2; we may add us-east-1 for failover but want to understand cost delta before committing.
- Legal: nothing unusual yet; will surface if procurement/legal asks for redlines.
- QBR windows: we prefer the week of 6/12 or 6/19; two 60-min slots on 6/13 (10–11 PT) or 6/20 (11–12 PT) work for our execs.

On security evidence: can you confirm the expected format and the turnaround time for SOC2 artifacts? Also, we have a short internal security questionnaire that might need some answers — attaching it to this reply (attached: gridly_security_questionnaire.docx).

Olivia
Head of Product, Gridly.ai
olivia.grant@gridly.ai

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2028 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Up-sell / Renewal kickoff: timeline, QBR scheduling & ops checklist

Thanks Olivia — appreciated. A few follow-ups from Redwood Sales / Solutions:

1) Procurement: Samir, great to meet you. I will loop in Redwood finance for PO guidance and provide a clean SOW + amendment draft by end of Week 1.

2) Regions & cost delta: ops team — estimated delta for adding us-east-1 in addition to us-west-2 is ~12% on committed units; we can provide a short model. If Gridly wants reserved capacity in both regions we recommend reserving the majority in us-west-2 and a small standby in us-east-1 for seasonal bursts.

3) Security & evidence: Kimberley, can you take point on SOC2 evidence and the questionnaire Olivia mentioned?

4) QBR: Mina — I'll be on the call to present the capacity forecast and cost model.

Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Hi all —

Kimberly here from Redwood Security & Compliance. Thanks for including me. Two quick notes on evidence and the questionnaire:

- SOC2 artifacts: we can provide the standard SOC2 report PDF and a mapped evidence pack (CSV index + links). Typical turnaround for curated evidence is 3–5 business days after the MAP items are accepted.
- Questionnaire: I reviewed the gridly_security_questionnaire.docx attached in Olivia's reply. I've answered items that map to public artifacts and flagged 3 items that will require a short call with Gridly Ops (about KMS/keys, retention window, and egress controls).

Next steps from security: I will upload the evidence index to the MAP (link below) and propose a 30-min ops sync to go over the three flagged items. Proposed times: Thu 5/31 9–9:30 PT or Fri 6/1 11–11:30 PT.

Attachments uploaded: SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (stub), evidence_index.csv (uploaded to MAP)

Thanks,
